Corn and Soybeans
Corn and Soybean Delayed Price
Effective December 3, 2025
Any corn or soybeans delivered after Dec 3, 2025 will recieve free delayed pricing.
Effective September 15, 2025
Flat Rate - $.00/bu
Monthly Rate - $.12/bu
No DP Charges if priced within 7 calendar days of delivery. Monthly rate is prorated daily.
Delayed Priced Grain cannot be used to fill forward contracts or be transferred to open storage per state regulations. If you do not have a current delayed price agreement on file, please request from the office and return.
New Crop Delayed Pricing rates are typically established before harvest and subject to market conditions. Any bushels remaining on delayed price, whether on free delayed price or delayed price receiving charges, begin incurring the new charges on the date the new rates begin.
**Due to market changes, these rates are subject to change without notice**
Corn and Soybean Open Storage
Effective September 15, 2025
Flat Rate - $.20/bu
Monthly Rate - $.12/bu
No DP Charges if priced within 7 calendar days of delivery. Monthly rate is prorated daily.
**Due to market changes, these rates are subject to change without notice**
Wheat
Effective June 29, 2026
Wheat Delayed Price
Flat rate $.00
Monthly Rate $.08/bu
No Charge if priced within 10 days.
Wheat Open Storage
Flat Rate $.15/bu
Monthly Rate $.10/bu
No charge if priced within 10 days.
Plenish Growers
If you are a Plenish grower, please have a sign in your window notifying the scales that you have plenish beans to dump. We need to know this before you are sent to the dump. We have copies of signs available if needed. Thank you!
Marketing Programs
The Farmers Elevator has several different grain marketing programs. We offer Cash Contracts, Forward Contracts, Basis Contracts, Hedge to Arrive Contracts and Purchasing of Options.
Grain Hauling
The elevator hauls grain off the farm. Please call the Pleasant Bend office for prices and to get your name on the list to have your grain hauled.
